svg.title: frame-loop, cut across: from the words at the top to the code at the bottom
svg.desc: A cross-section. Claude stands on the left and you on the right. Your sentence is the top band, where the work begins and returns. Below it each place, the root and every part split from it, a cycle: your words become rows and the commands you approve, the check reads each row, and a crossing splits the place into parts, each a place that goes through the same again; you approve the crossing whole. Below those each turn, drawn as a pan on the heat: the code as written lies on top, still; the change, described in plain lines, churns beneath it, with the extra lines caught apart; at the bottom the check, by readers that are not Claude, glows. What needs you rises to you, with its reason; a row that passed stays below as a mark.
svg.text: what is asked, in your words · where the work begins and returns
the same at the root and in each part, as deep as the work needs
your words, one claim a row
into parts, each with its files,
where the work becomes code, and the code is checked
the change a turn made in its part's files
in plain lines, each one thing a person
by readers shown only those lines, in fixed trials · Gadfly
the loop: down as your rows, round through the code, up as the check, and back to your words
